reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: LD-aware fine mapping, context-matched molecular-QTL colocalization and allele/gene perturbation comparisons.

checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult primary fine-mapping/colocalization Methods or versioned tool documentation to select conditions and verify their transfer before analysis. Tool names and a proposed sequence do not satisfy this check.
Names posterior output and a 95% set but does not explain model-conditional causal-signal/priors assumptions or uncertainty when multiple signals are present.

checks.quote: Colocalization bridges the variant to the effector gene
checks.reason: Focuses on distinct variants in LD but omits the equally central non-mediation case in which a genuinely shared variant independently affects expression and the trait; shared signal is not an effector-gene proof.
An irrelevant tissue need not guarantee absence of an eQTL or a functional effect, and a null may reflect power/detection. The deterministic decision does not distinguish these outcomes.

Proposes endogenous/allelic perturbation and a separate G-versus-H gene intervention with molecular and trait-relevant readouts, while identifying model-context limits. These independent comparisons are sufficiently operational for this conceptual essay; no full wet-lab SOP is required by profile A.

checks.quote: must first use epigenomic enrichment tools
checks.reason: Does not define a robustness comparison for LD, priors or context selection. Genome-wide tissue enrichment cannot make a required definitive locus-specific tissue choice.

checks.quote: statistical signatures of the variants are identical
checks.reason: Near-perfect LD does not make statistical signatures exactly identical; the later perfect-LD example is valid but does not repair the broader statement.

checks.quote: This is the only step that definitively proves the biological inferential chain.
checks.reason: Parallel allele and gene perturbation effects do not definitively establish that the allele phenotype is mediated through that gene; pleiotropy, clonal and contextual routes remain.

Addresses the four requested steps, candidate G/H and distal alternatives, statistical-versus-biological evidence and proposed rather than performed analyses. No additional distinct defect beyond the explicitly recorded checks.
